BOTTOM LEFT: John Thresher and Gerry North bring the Bels home in first place in the "London Clubs' Two Mile" team final. Don Maclean was 3rd and Bill Kerr 7th.
Gerry North hands over to Pat Newell
CENTRE RIGHT: Barry Sawyer hands over to Gerry North at the end of stage 8.
LOWER CENTRE: Gerry storms past a Belgrave Supporters coach during his devastating run on stage 9.

HEY!------WHAT'S THAT?-----'OUR CHAS' TAKING A PEP PILL? Eddie Lacey's action picture seems to catch Charlie Walker in the act during the Club '7' with 2½ miles to go. He certainly needed it, for Gerry North (no pill) passed him shortly after to win by over a minute.

CENTRE: The leaders at 2½ miles. Batty, Briault and Johnston lead from Craig, Strong, Turner and Fowler with Don Taylor and Montague partly hidden. Heatley (the winner) and Bullivant complete the leading group. Gerry North, Simpson and Kilby lead the following bunch.
Photos (full page montage; captions on page 12)
BOTTOM LEFT: Gerry North (2) seems to have hit the tape first in the AAA v London University 2 miles---but award went to Mel Batty. Both clocked 8:52.8.

The Brighton in PHOTOS: TOP LEFT: Pat Newell takes the baton from Bill Kerr to set off on Stage 10 with a 2 minutes lead. TOP RIGHT: Laurie O'Hara gives Gerry North the lead we all hoped for---46 secs over Portsmouth after 7 stages. John Davies, behind, takes a time-check. CENTRE LEFT: That long stretch of empty road behind Gerry North lengthens with every stride. CENTRE RIGHT:Bill Kerr clocks fastest time on Stage 9---the longest at 6 miles-52 yards. BOTTOM LEFT: The picture Eddie Lacey has waited 22 'Brightons' for---Belgrave crossing the line 3mins-10secs ahead of Portsmouth. BOTTOM RIGHT:Alan Black hands the presentation baton to the Mayor of Brighton Councillor S.D. Deason J.P. Photos by E.D.L. & R.L.

FRONTISPIECE (Photo:Sport & General) Gerry North leads R. Gomez during the Southern '6' at Motspur Park. North won in 28:40.4.

Gerry North and Alan Black lead Geoff North (1), O'Hara (5), Thorpe (18), Fairclough (16) and Dabbs (27) shortly after the start.

PHOTO (E.LACEY) Gerry North (30), running for Surrey in the Inter-Counties Champs. at the White City in June, is seen here just behind Barlow of Cheshire in the early stages of the race. The race was won by J. Alder in 28:04 and Gerry was 5th in 28:23.8. John Thresher was the other Belgrave member of the victorious Surrey team, finishing 6th in the mile with 4:05,8.
Gerry North leading the "Racing Holts", soon after the start of the Surrey '6' which he won in record time .

1960 - John Merriman leads Gerry and Gordon Pirie in the National C.C.Champ. at West Bromwich. Basil Heatley was the winner and Gerry finished 4th.

Dick Piotrowski and Gerry North (left) chase Geoff North during the '5¾'. Dick fell back at four miles leaving Gerry to finish second, 27 secs down on his brother.

No, he's not winning! But he is running a fine race ahead of Freary, Hill, Plain and Jackson in the National Championships. GERRY NORTH eventually finished 17th.
GERRY NORTH, fast regaining his old form, wins the 5,000 metres in the Southern League match at Wimbledon Park with a time of 14:45.2.
Good enough for the G.B. 4x100m. team, this change-over between Gerry North and John Bicourt in the Surrey road relay.
This looks like a fair old field, and it is. Gerry North leads Bob Richardson, Jim Alder, Ron Hill, Tim Johnston, the great Gaston Roelants and Ron Grove in the Coca-Cola 30,000m.
Gerry North made a bold bid to win the Southern Counties cross-country championship, and might have succeeded had it not been for some trouble with the stitch. Here he is on his way to fourth place.
GERRY NORTH leads Biscoe (Mitcham AC) and Roberts (S.L.H.)
GERRY NORTH finishes a fine run on stage 5 to hand over to COLIN PEARSON in second place, only 4 seconds behind the leaders, Reading.
The devil-take-the-hindmost race at Ravensbury Park. Last man left running was Gerry North.
Back Page: Belgrave Cross Country Captain Gerry North, a past winner of the National cross country race, has decided to call it a day as far as the 'National' goes.

January 3rd 1970 at Milford Heath and no. 80, Bob Holt (Hercules Wimbledon), leads the Surrey Senior Cross Country Championships from no. 13, Gerry North (Belgrave). Bob eventually won with Gerry runner up and Dave Holt, pictured behind Bob, 3rd. Also to be seen are Chris Wade of Ranelagh (brother of tennis star Virginia), no. 11 Adrian Major (Belgrave) who placed 5th, no. 77, Mick Fuller (Hercules Wimbledon) and we can just spot Bob Gevers (SLH). Hercules Wimbledon won the team race from Mitcham with the Bels. 3rd.

Left: Enjoying the occasion.  Pat Mead, Tony Binda, Marianne Black, Gerry North, Alan Black, the late Laurie O'Hara, George Piddington, Charlie Henn, Ted Pallant, Chris Steer, Charlie Manning.

Sadly this was the last time that we saw Laurie O'Hara.  He died the following day while out running.

The International Cross Country Championships, Leopardstown Racecourse, Dublin, 21st March 1964.

The Belgrave Cross Country Captain Gerry North, representing England, leads Jim Hogan of Polytechnic H & Ireland. They finished a fine 4th and 5th respectively. England won the race with 38 points from France, 96, and Morocco, 149.
Gerry is pictured after his win in the Southern Counties AAA 6 miles track championship at Motspur Park on 25 April 1964. He won in 28:40.4, beating Ron Gomez of Southgate.

Happy with a seventh successive year in the medals at the National Road Relay.
